newsitem.title: USA: U.S. energy futures pare losses in ACCESS trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. energy futures pare losses in ACCESS trade.

text.p: U.S. energy futures pared losses in after-hours trade amid uncertainty about a bearish news report claiming the U.S. asked Saudi Arabia to raise crude oil production.
"We're up in crude because (the report) hasn't been sorted out yet," one trader said.
NYMEX October crude oil futures traded around $23.28 a barrel in early ACCESS trade, up about nine cents from the settle on 1,100 lots.
October heating oil futures climbed 31 points to 65.60 cents a gallon. October gasoline futures edged up 0.13 cent a gallon to 63 cents a gallon on 108 lots traded.
